body.name: \mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{reg}}
body.construction:
\[
\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{reg}}(r_{0n},r_{1n},r_{en};\eta_-,\eta_+,\sigma_0^2,\sigma_1^2,M,\bar r)
=\Bigl\{(P,m_0,m_1,p):(r_{0n},r_{1n},r_{en})\in[0,\bar r]^3,
\ \eta_-+\eta_+<1,\text{ and, at sample size }n,\ \texttt{ass:iid},
\ \texttt{ass:consistency},\ \texttt{ass:ignorability},
\ \texttt{ass:uniform-overlap-comparator},\ \texttt{ass:treated-residual-variance},
\ \texttt{ass:control-residual-variance},\ \texttt{ass:bounded-treatment-effect-signal},
\ \texttt{ass:public-g0-radius},\ \texttt{ass:public-g1-radius},
\text{ and }\texttt{ass:public-e-radius}\text{ hold}\Bigr\}.
\]
